parent_objective: implement no-rerun bounded diagnostic comparison over scene-backed candidates
blocked_by: M2217 design must freeze diagnostic tables, labels, and claim boundary
supersedes: manual profile ranking from M2215 support slices

public_gates: M2218 must use only M2209 and M2215 artifacts
M2218 must write bounded diagnostic tables
M2218 must keep ranking_admissible false and winner_selected false
M2218 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, policy action, training, replay, or PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns scene-backed candidates into diagnostic matrices without ranking
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rerun diagnostic tables only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if scene-backed filtering is ignored
stop if policy or environment code executes
fallback_plan: route to result audit if diagnostic tables are complete
route to task/profile repair if all support is concentrated
route to synthesis if diagnostics do not change route evidence

allowed_updates: M2218 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2218 reanalyzes outcome diagnostics and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2218.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If diagnostic support is profile/history concentrated, record that as diagnostic evidence rather than claiming self-ID or ranking.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: converts scene-backed support into diagnostic matrices
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether public current-sim support is diagnostic only or worth a later comparison route
must_synthesize_if: M2218 would lead to another blind repair

hypothesis: Scene-backed M2215 candidates can be converted into diagnostic matrices without ranking or rerun.
success_criteria: no reset rollout measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new rollout or ranking is performed
decision_rule: M2218 passes if it writes no-rerun diagnostic matrices while keeping ranking and winner selection blocked.
